Advertisement for Faculty
Monday, 11 November 2019
5937 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts.
1. Professors in TB & Chest (open-1), Dentistry (Open-1), Obst & Gynae (ST-1), Radiotherapy (Open-1)
2. Associate Professors in Orthopaedics (ST-1), Obst and Gynae (ST-1), Radiotherapy (open- 1), Surgery (Open-1), Dentistry (Open-1), Psychiatry (Open-1)
3. Assistant Professor in – General Medicine (SC-1, ST-1, VJ/NT-1, open-2), TB Chest (open-1), Skin & VD (open-1), Surgery (ST-1; VJ/NT-1), Ophthalmology (ST-1; open-1 ), ENT (ST-1), Obst. & Gynae (ST-1, VJ/NT-1, open-1) and (1 open –Lect. Cum M&CWO; 1 open Lecturer-cum-AMO) , Anaesthesiology (ST-1; open-1), Radiodiagnosis (ST-1), Radiotherapy (SC-1)
The applicant should send their applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience  certificates/testimonials for the above posts to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) till
2/12/2019
. The appointments would be temporary for next two academic years or till the next regular Selection Committee of MUHS meets whichever is earlier and as per MUHS direction 1/2017.
Qualification
: MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience
: As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale
: As per the rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details please contact:
Phone: 07152 -284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203) fax: 07152-284333, 284220
Email:
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Website: www.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
